project_type: Python FastAPI multi-agent investment analysis platform with Bloomberg-style web dashboard
test_framework: pytest with conftest.py fixtures, FastAPI TestClient
build_command: pip install -e '.[dev,data]' fastapi uvicorn jinja2 httpx
verification_instructions: Run pytest to confirm all tests pass, then verify new tests cover new code paths
setup_instructions: pyenv global 3.11.15 && pip install -e '.[dev,data]' fastapi uvicorn jinja2 httpx
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode, no Docker daemon needed. pyenv 3.11.15 is active.
contribution_requirements: Commit in Chinese, push to main, bump version in pyproject.toml, update CHANGELOG
key_patterns: Frontend: Jinja2 templates with inline <script> blocks, vanilla JS, Bloomberg dark theme CSS. Backend: FastAPI app in dashboard/app.py, data layer in src/augur/data.py, datasources chain in src/augur/datasources/. Tests: tests/test_*.py using pytest + TestClient. 18 persona agents in src/augur/personas/.
directory_structure: dashboard/ (Flask/FastAPI web app, templates/, static/), src/augur/ (core lib: api, data, registry, coordinator, report, personas/, datasources/, bots/), tests/ (pytest), docs/ (CHANGELOG, guides), personas/custom/ (YAML personas)
